prompts.name: A · 上方橫向 tab
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity proposal for the main inventory panel of an existing Taiwanese classic Lineage-style pixel-art RPG. Generate ONE front-facing standalone inventory panel, portrait 600 x 1000 composition on plain dark backdrop, the whole outer frame visible, no other game scene, no comparison sheet. INPUT IMAGE 1 is the APPROVED VISUAL TARGET: its ornate aged silver frame, charcoal stone/leather interior, restrained old-school dark green-black cells, ORIGINAL old low-resolution item sprites, cyan locked-cell tint, gold padlocks, small blue +N enhancement badges and muted gold quantity badges. INPUT IMAGE 2 is ONLY a reference for the existing functions and Traditional Chinese labels, NOT a visual target. Match image 1's original late-1990s RPG art very closely, retain its slightly weathered pixel-painted style rather than sleek modern fantasy illustration. The inventory is EXACTLY FOUR columns by SIX rows of PERFECT SQUARE CELLS: cell width equals height everywhere. Every icon must be fully visible inside its square and preserve original proportions. Do NOT copy the squashed rows or heavy individual ornamental frames of input image 2. The individual cells have BLACK backgrounds and only a single thin straight desaturated gray-green dividing line; all elaborate silver ornament belongs ONLY to the OUTER perimeter. Use a mix of original-looking helmets, boots, cloaks, rings, necklaces, gloves and a few empty cells drawn like the visual target, with room around sprites. Main category tabs are 武器 / 防具 / 道具, with 防具 selected. All typography Traditional Chinese with restrained pale bone text and selected tab in muted warm gold; all tabs must share the exact same aged silver, black stone and leather material as the panel, no modern pills, rainbow colors or neon. Include compact search field labeled 搜尋名稱, optional armor subfilters 全部 / 防具 / 飾品 / 腰帶, and compact functional controls 整理背包 / 快速強化 / 快速廢品. These controls must occupy modest space so the square grid remains dominant. Keep a discreet vertical scroll rail at the right of the grid. No oversized title block, gradients of bright color, repeated thick slot borders, decorative objects outside the panel, advertising, or invented gameplay controls. Visual concept only; item counts and enhancement examples are illustrative.

VARIANT A — most faithful original silver-frame design. Place a single compact horizontal row of THREE raised rectangular silver-and-stone category tabs just under the top silver ornament, all equal width and visibly attached to the inventory frame. Selected 防具 tab has a thin muted gold underline and slightly warmer stone face. Search row below it, then slim armor subfilter row, then the 4x6 square grid. Put the three utility actions together in one low-height bottom bar. Maintain the original target's generous stone rim around the grid; clean, practical and compact. No huge heading: the category tabs identify the page.
